propositions: Outbound create mutations must target the ticket's resolved project from the mapping rather than the client's construction-time default project.
The cross-project guard must validate target keys against the store's project set membership rather than equality with a single configured project.
The reserved _bridge_target_project key must be resolved once during mutation build, stamped into create fields, and read by both Cloud and DC transports to override their defaults.
Both Cloud and DC transports must drop _bridge_target_project before sending payloads to avoid invalid tracker field errors.
A ticket resolving to a project not in the mapping set must emit no create mutation to prevent writes to unsynced projects.
The guard's caller must supply the store's project set from the mapping, falling back to the single project for backwards compatibility with unseeded stores.
